title: TRICARE Select Claim Denials for Authorization, Timely Filing and Eligibility
content:
**Rules on payability of TRICARE Select claim lines.**

1. A line whose service class is in the tier's prior-authorization list is payable only when an approved authorization for the patient covers the provider and the service date. A line without one is denied as denied for no authorization (no deductible, no cost share, no TRICARE payment); emergency admissions are covered without prior authorization when the facility notified the region within the notification window.

> **Retired only within a declared scope.** For a line reprocessed for other health insurance found retroactively, and for a line reprocessed for the catastrophic cap - and only for such a line - the clause in item 1 that the line is payable only with an approved authorization covering the provider and the service date is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis for those reprocessed lines. For every other TRICARE Select line the clause remains in force as written.

2. A claim received more than the tier's claim filing deadline after the service date (or, for inpatient stays, the discharge date) is denied as denied for untimely filing, unless the provider's or beneficiary's documented reason was retroactive DEERS eligibility or another insurer's late processing.
3. Specialty care needs no referral under **TRICARE Select**.
4. A line for a date of service on which the patient had no active Select enrollment is denied as denied for no eligibility.

## Timely filing boundary (hypothetical, 365-day deadline)

| Service date (or discharge date) | Claim received | Result |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-02-10 | 2027-02-10 (365 days after) | within the deadline |
| 2026-02-10 | 2027-02-11 (366 days after) | denied for untimely filing, unless the documented reason was retroactive DEERS eligibility or another insurer's late processing |

## Denial outcomes

| Outcome | Deductible | Cost share | TRICARE payment |
|---|---|---|---|
| denied for no authorization | none | none | none |
| denied for untimely filing | none | none | none |
| denied for no eligibility | none | none | none |

superseded_clauses: A line whose service_class is in prior_authorization_required_service_classes is payable only when an approved authorization for the patient covers the provider and the service date.
